title: Menemen (Turkish scrambled eggs with tomatoes and peppers)
steps: Finely dice the onion and pepper and soften them in the oil for 4 minutes.
Dice the tomatoes, add them and cook down for 4 minutes.
Beat the eggs, pour them into the pan and let them set softly, stirring now and then.
Sprinkle with salt, chilli flakes, feta and parsley and serve with pitta.
